detail.longDescription: I'm Ilias, the creator behind Orcah Studio (a local-first knowledge system that will transcribe, perform speaker diarization, analyse frames, and create multi-modal embeddings) using open-weight models Demo video: https://youtu.be/9uUZrayDEgs I built a Docker-first solution, fully open source here: https://github.com/IliasHad/orcah-studio Plus, a desktop app that will be plug-and-play with a richer video indexing pipeline. With integrations with DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, and Adobe Premiere Pro, and MCP tools (over 45 tools). You can even link your videos with your Strava activities and extract camera metadata like ISO, Shutter Speed, Lens Model, and location, if available. You can even do the same in your iPhone videos (index your videos in your videos, sync them with your Mac-indexed videos, so you can search them from your Mac or the other way). (Early alpha for now) And even index videos on your Linux machine (alpha version) and use the macOS application as a client for that machine. The goal is to make your videos indexable, searchable and most importantly, to build a memory from all your videos and connect the dots. Instead of just building a memory for a specific video, we can connect and link between all the videos that you have, without uploading anything to the cloud or paying us a subscription (one-time fee, no subscription fatigue or reminders haha) Here's the macOS app that you can buy and start indexing your videos now: https://orcah.app
